clips.title: The story
paras: Ghamoo-ra is an ancient, giant sea turtle inhabiting the Pool of Ask'ar within Blackfathom Deeps, the sunken temple of Elune now overrun by the Twilight's Hammer cult. Armored in a massive shell, he savagely tramples any intruders who approach his island.

Blackfathom Deeps was once a night elven temple dedicated to Elune, now flooded and claimed by naga, satyr and the nihilistic Twilight's Hammer cult. Ghamoo-ra dwells among its drowned ruins, an enormous turtle whose thick shell turns aside all but the most determined blows.
